book.name: Yohane
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Yohane

content: Yecho ikamulwa

Yecho pajhomolila kunnyopa Chapanga, jwenio na bhabholwa bhake bhajhakujhomboka kwiye jha lukemba lwa ku Kedulone. Peniya pakibha na buchitane jha Michaitune, Yecho na bhabholwa bhake bhajhakujhingii mwenio.
Yuda jwanyambila Yecho jhola, akapamanye peniya, nhwalo Yecho ahwelita na bhabholwa bhake.

Peniya Yuda ajhakujhenda pabuchitane jha Michaitune pamonga na akakomana ngondo bha kilume na pamonga akalonda bha nyumba jha Chapanga bhibhatumitwe na akapiya matambiko bhakolongwa na Mapwalichayo, bhajhakuhika na lumule na limbolembole na indukwa na mikowa.
Yecho akamanyite ghoha ghimpala kunkolela, ajhakwajhendelela na kwakonya, “Bho, mangota mipalaha ghane?”
ngabhanyangwila, “Yecho jwa ku Nachalete.” Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Ndi nenga.” Yuda jwanyambila Yecho akajhemite pahina na bheniya.
Yecho pabhalobholila, “Nenga ndi,” bhajhakubhujha kihenga nyuma na kugwegha pahe puuu.
Yecho ajhakwakonya kabhele, “Mangota mipalaha ghane?” Pibhajhangwila, “Yecho jwa ku Nachalete.”
Yecho pabhalongalila, “Nikanobholile kubhehe ndi nenga, na anda nenga ndi jhumumbalaha, mwaleke bhamba bhajhende.”
Alongila naha ghalongila makacho ghalenganile ghighalongila, “Tate, bhando bhumbekiya nikahobhiche ndeka hilu jhumo.”
Bhahe, Simone Petile nganholomwila upanga muchako, ajhakutondobheya na kuheketa lichikilo lya lubhoko lwalelo lya ntumiche jwa Mpiya Litambiko Nkolongwa. Ntumiche jwenio liina lyake Malukuse.
Bhahe, Yecho ajhakunnobholela Petile, “Mmujhiche upanga gwino kuntohila! Bho, mipala ngotoka kunywegha mukibaba cha malagho nganenganikiye Tate gwango?”
Yecho ipelekwa kwa Anase
Bhahe, lilongo lya akakomana ngondo bha Kilume na nkolo jwabhe na akalonda bha Nyumba bha Chapanga jha Akayahude bhajhakunkamula Yecho, na kuntabha pyee,
bhajhakutumbuu kumpeleka kwa Anase. Anase akibha nkohano mundo Kayafa, Kayafa akibha Mpiya litambiko nkolo kwa chaka chenie.
Kayafa ndi jhojholajhola jwabhalongolila bhakolo bha Akayahude, mbaha mundo jhumo ahweghe kwa kwaghombokola bhando bhoha.
Petile inkana Yecho
Simone Petile pamonga na mmolwa jhonge bhajhakunkengamila Yecho. Nhwalo mmolwa jhola jhonge akamanyikine na Mpiya Litambiko Nkolo, peniya bhajhakujhingii pamonga na Yecho pa Bwalo.

Nambo Petile ajhakujhema panja jha nnyango. Peniya mmolwa jwamanyikina na Mpiya litambiko nkolo ajhakupita panja na kulonge na mwikeghe nnonda jwa nnyango, peniya mwikeghe jhola ajhakunekekeya Petile ajhingii nkate.
Nchikana jhola nnonda jwa nnyango ajhakunkonya Petile, “Bho, mwenga chi jhumo jwa mmolwa jwa mundo jhonjo?” Petila pajhangwila, “Nahijhe nenga chi mmolwa gwake.”
Nhwalo kukibha na malile akatumiche na akalonda bhajhakukungana mwotu na kujhota. Na jwenio Petile akajhemite pamonga nabho ajhotita mwotu.
Yecho palonge jha Mpiya Litambiko
Bhahe, Mpiya litambiko nkolo ajhakunkonya Yecho panane jha bhabholwa na mabholo ghake.
Yecho ngalongila, “Nongila hotuhotu na bhando, molita munyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude na pa Nyumba jha Chapanga, pubhakonganika Akayahude bhoha, kibhiijhe kilebhe chindehila mungwapa.
Nhwalo ghane chiungonya nenga naha? Mwakonyekehe bhando bhala ghabhajhohine. Mwakonye chanalobhalile, nhwalo bhamanye chinongile.”
Yecho palongila malobhe gheniya, nnonda jhumo akibha pahina jhake ajhakunapula mbalamande lapu alongila, “Nhwalo ghane munyanguu Mpiya litambiko nkolo!”
Yecho pajhangwila, “Anda nyangwii mbone ndeka nnongele kilebhe chenie palonge jha bhando. Nambo anda nyangwii mbone, nhwalo gwa nike umatwii mbalamande?”
Peniya Anase ajhakuntutuhana Yecho kongo bhantabhite pyee ade kwa Kayafa ndi Mpiya litambiko nkolo.
Petile ankana kabhele Yecho
Bhahe, Simone Petile akibha ajhemite peniya ajhota mwotu, bhando bhajhakunkonya, “Bho, na mwenga helahela chi mmolwa jwa mundo jhonjo?” Nambo Petile ajhakukana alongila, “Ne ndeka.”
Ntumiche jhumo jwa Mpiya litambiko nkolo, nnongo jwa jhola jwakapyekwitwe lichikilo na Petile, ajhakunkonya, “Bho, mbona nikamwene mundo jhonjo pamonga kubuchitane jha Micheitune kola?”
Nambo Petile ajhakukana kabhele, papalapala lijhogholo lijhakubheka.
Yecho palonge jha Pilatu

Pukuchila tugha putiputi bhajhakuntola Yecho kubhoka ku munyumba jha Kayafa na kunhikicha ku liboma lya nduna jwa Loma. Bhakolo bha Akayahude bhakajhingii ndeka nkate jha liboma lyenio, nhwalo bhapata bhabhehe nyahinyahi palonge jha Chapanga bhalyeghe chakulya cha Pachaka.
Bhahe, Pilatu ajhakupita panja na kwakonya, “Mundo jhonjone alemwite nike ade mtakalile?”
Ngabhajhangwila, “Anda mundo jhonjo nakulemwajhe ngatuhikiche jhe kwino mwenga.”
Pilatu ajhakwalobholela, “Mtutuhane mabhene na mukahadabule kulenganii lilaghalikilo lino.” Akayahude pibhajhangwila, “Twenga tukwete jhe ukindendeke gwa kuhadabula na kukoma mundo jhojhoha.”
Itendika naha lilobhe lya Yecho lilongila, kwalangiya chajhenda kuwegha.
Peniya Pilatu ajhakujhingii nkate jha liboma kabhele na kunkema Yecho na kunkonya, “Bho, mwenga ndi Munahota nkolongwa jwa Akayahude?”
Yecho ajhakunkonya, “Bho, malobhe gheniya ghihuma nkate jhino amu bhando bhange bhanongolile malobhe ghango?”
Pilatu ngajhangwila, “Bho, mihambuka nenga Nayahude? Bhando bha kilambo chino na akapiya matambiko ndi bhibhantutuhine kwa nenga. Bho, nnemwite nike?”

Yecho pajhangwila, “Unahota Nkolongwa gwango chi pannema pano. Unahota Nkolongwa ngaubhehe gwa pannema, bhando bhubhakibha bhibhankengima ngabhakengilile ngotoka kukamulwa na bhakolo bha Akayahude. Nambo unahota nkolongwa gwango gwapamba ndeka!”

Peniya Pilatu pankonyita, “Bho, mwenga ndi munahota nkolongwa?” Yecho ngajhangwila, “Mabhene ndi milonge nenga munahota nkolongwa. Nenga melwike kwa nhwalo gwenio na kuhika pannema pano kwalobholela bhando malobhe gha uchakaka, bhando bhibhapala uchakaka ujhokanikiya malobhe ghango.”

Bhahe, Pilatu ajhakunkonya Yecho, “Uchakaka ndi kilebhe ghane?” Yecho bhihadabuu akomwe Matei 27:15-31; Maluku 15:6-20; Luka 23:13-25 Pilatu pajhomolila kulonge gheniya ajhakupita panja kabhele kwalobholela Akayahude, “Nenga nikihwe ndeka chalemwite ade kunhadabula mundo jhonjo.
Nambo kulengana na nikayobhalikiye mangota kudindulila mpungwa jhumo machiko gha Unyagho gwa Pachaka. Bho, mipala ninyogholele jhonjo Munahota Nkolongwa jwa Akayahude?”
Peniya bhajhakutumbuu kuchobhela, “Nahi jhe jwenio ndeka! Tupala mutudindulile Balaba!” Balaba akibha apokita ilebhe ya bhando kwa makakala.
